name: Hawaii Kai
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Hawaii Kai, HI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Hawaii Kai, Oahu for 2026: a holiday parade at Koko Marina Center and a marina boat parade, checked on host sites.
lede: Hawaii Kai celebrates Christmas with a street parade down Lunalilo Home Road and a boat parade across the marina.
celebrates: Hawaii Kai marks the season with two community parades, one on land and one on the water. The Hawaii Kai Holiday Parade is coordinated by the Hawaii Kai Lions Club and sponsored by Koko Marina Center, and it ends with a Christmas Carnival Celebration in the Marina Courtyard with Santa photos, crafts, balloon art and hula. A few weeks later, decorated boats light up the Hawaii Kai Marina for the Festival of Lights Christmas Boat Parade, which Hawaii Kai Towne Center lists as a free community tradition.
lastyear: In 2025 the Christmas Boat Parade was listed for Saturday, December 13, beginning at sunset, about 5:30 pm, as a free community event, according to a university calendar and a social post for the parade. The Hawaii Kai Lions Club describes its street parade as a much anticipated community tradition held on the Saturday after Thanksgiving. For 2026 the street parade is on November 28 and the boat parade on December 19.
facts: The Hawaii Kai Lions Club says its holiday parade has run since 1969, and calls it the club's largest service project, with more than 1,200 participants and volunteers and about 30 decorated floats and vehicles. Wikipedia says Hawaii Kai was dredged from Kuapa Pond starting around 1959 and developed largely by Henry J. Kaiser, with a marina and channels cut through what had been a fishpond.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Hawaii Kai. The Hawaiian Railway Society museum in Ewa Beach, on the far side of Oahu, is the nearest rail museum on our site. For rides closer to home, the Waikiki Trolley Holiday Lights Tour and the Holly Jolly Waikiki Trolley run from Honolulu, and both are listed on our Honolulu page.
train_links: A heritage railway museum on the west side of Oahu.

kidfact: Hawaii Kai's marina was dug out of an old Hawaiian fishpond, so the boats in the Christmas parade float where fish were once raised.
faq: How does Hawaii Kai celebrate Christmas?

The Hawaii Kai Holiday Parade comes down Lunalilo Home Road on the Saturday after Thanksgiving and ends at Koko Marina Center, where a carnival with Santa photos and crafts follows. In December, decorated boats take part in the Festival of Lights Christmas Boat Parade on the Hawaii Kai Marina.
Are the Hawaii Kai Christmas events free?
Yes. Both parades are free to watch. Carnival games at Koko Marina Center are free with a new unwrapped toy, according to the center's event page.
Where can kids meet Santa in Hawaii Kai?
Koko Marina Center lists photos with Santa Claus at its Christmas Carnival Celebration in the Marina Courtyard from 11 am to 1 pm on the day of the holiday parade.
Where is the best place to watch the boat parade?
Hawaii Kai Towne Center invites families to gather at its Marina Docks Courtyard, 333 Keahole St, and suggests coming early to eat or shop first.
Is there a train ride in Hawaii Kai?
We did not find one. The Hawaiian Railway Society museum in Ewa Beach is the nearest rail museum on our site.
